name: Commercial Loan Underwriting Check
outcome: Checks the two numbers a credit committee starts with: debt-service coverage and risk-adjusted pricing. art-363 rebuilds the borrower's coverage ratios (basic/cash/FCF DSCR, FCCR, EBIT- and EBITDA-basis ICR, leverage in x EBITDA) against its five-category lender matrix; art-362 prices the loan on a risk-adjusted return-on-capital basis and reports the spread needed to clear the hurdle rate; cry-05 aggregates the run's execution receipts. Steps are independent runs; step-1 ratios and execution hashes are cited for manual comparison. The pricer takes user-supplied inputs. Not a credit decision.
